svg.title: FIG 03 · model updates
svg.desc: Line drawing of a model update as five checkpoint gates on a track: download (WorkManager, from a Firebase manifest), verify (size and SHA-256), encrypt (AES-GCM with an Android Keystore key), warm (load and run every model once), activate. An update token passes through; now and then a model fails to load at the warm gate and the Engine rolls back to the previous set.
svg.text: new models reach phones in the field · a bad set fails while loading, never at a reading
